title: Deliver tracker-only PRs without commit contracts
body:
Observed defect (PR #160, 2026-11-01): krn deliver cannot deliver a tracker-only PR. Branch commit validation (src/flow/repository.ts, used by preflight and review) accepts only `<test file>:red->green|green->green` Change-contract trailers and refuses `none (...)`, while deliver's mergeMessage (src/deliver/message.ts:25) throws "PR commits require Change-contract trailers" when no commit carries one. The lead had to replay deliver by hand: publish krn/judge-* statuses, run the host-locked gate, krn ship, then fast-forward the main checkout, archive the review series and retire the worktree, all of which deliver normally does.
Acceptance: for a PR whose diff touches only tasks/*.json and whose commits carry no Change-contract, deliver builds the merge message with exactly `Change-contract: none (tracker records only; no executable surface; krn task check runs in the gate)` and completes the same stages as for a code PR; a PR that touches any other path with no commit contract is still refused. Observer: a deliver message test red at the base by assertion for the tracker-only case, green at head, with the refusal case unchanged.
